tagline: hololive opened the EXPO 2027 ticket window on Thursday, Takanashi Kiara's album is getting pressed on vinyl, Jacksepticeye went full VTuber for Make-A-Wish, and the Streamer Awards found a second act in a brief margin post and its deletion. AFA Singapore and DreamHack Stockholm are four days out.
inThisIssue: hololive SUPER EXPO 2027 and hololive 8th fes. Brand-New Fanfare — venue and streaming tickets now open; first lottery ends November 29; three days at Makuhari Messe March 12-14, 2027; Tokoyami Towa confirmed not appearing
Takanashi Kiara's Vogelfrei gets an official vinyl release with Black Screen Records spring 2027 — first hololive LP press; pre-orders open now with Crunchyroll and AmiAmi exclusives
Jacksepticeye debuts VTuber avatar November 19 for Ironmouse's Wishmas fundraiser — medieval knight model for Make-A-Wish; mixed reception on design, broad agreement on the charity angle

lead.title: hololive SUPER EXPO 2027 and hololive 8th fes. Brand-New Fanfare — venue and streaming tickets go on sale November 20; first lottery deadline November 29; three days at Makuhari Messe, March 12-14, 2027
lead.body: COVER Corporation opened ticket sales for hololive SUPER EXPO 2027 and hololive 8th fes. Brand-New Fanfare on November 20 at 8:00 PM JST. The combined event runs three days at Makuhari Messe International Exhibition Halls, March 12-14, 2027 — the second consecutive three-day format after the expansion from two days in 2026. The venue lottery — the first purchase avenue — runs through 11:59 PM on Sunday, November 29, with payment and results December 4-8. A second presale through Lawson Ticket begins December 10. General sale opens at 12:00 PM on February 6, 2027. Streaming tickets for the 8th fes. went on sale simultaneously on SPWN and Streaming+ and are available through April 14, 2027. Single-day EXPO admission is 6,600 yen; 8th fes. reserved seats are 11,000 yen per day; a three-day streaming pass is 25,000 yen; single-stage streams are 6,800 yen. COVER confirmed that Tokoyami Towa will not appear at hololive SUPER EXPO 2027. Fast Tickets are again on the program to manage overnight queue lines. The event name Brand-New Fanfare nods toward the company's forthcoming 10th anniversary in 2028, though no anniversary event has been announced. The 7th fes., Ridin' on Dreams, ran March 6-8, 2026 at Makuhari Messe; the 2027 event stays at the same venue.

stories.title: Takanashi Kiara's second album Vogelfrei is getting an official vinyl release with Black Screen Records — spring 2027; pre-orders open now; Crunchyroll and AmiAmi hold exclusive colour variants
stories.blurb: COVER Corporation and Black Screen Records announced on November 17 that Takanashi Kiara's second studio album Vogelfrei will receive its first physical vinyl release in spring 2027. The record is a 1xLP coloured vinyl with new artwork by John Kafka and mastering by Chris Bethge. Pre-orders opened November 17 at 18:00 CET through the Black Screen Records store; a Crunchyroll-exclusive colour variant (US) and an AmiAmi-exclusive variant (Japan) are available through those channels. A Deluxe Edition with limited T-shirt, slipmat, and additional items is sold only through the Black Screen Records store. Black Screen Records is known for gaming and animation vinyl including Hotline Miami and Stardew Valley; the Kiara collaboration is their first hololive release. Vogelfrei was released digitally on February 8, 2026.

stories.title: NIJISANJI EN's WANNYANZ — the Alban Knox and Sonny Brisko duo — gets its first merch line; nine product types go on sale November 19 at 11:00 JST; plush mascots sold out at launch
stories.blurb: ANYCOLOR announced WANNYANZ merchandise on November 17, with sales opening November 18 at 18:00 PST / November 19 at 11:00 JST through the NIJISANJI EN Official Store and Nijisanji Store. The lineup spans nine product types: Plush Toy Mascot, Random Snapshot Card, Acrylic Stand, NIJIPUPE Outfit, Acrylic Plate, Sticker Set, Acrylic Block, Sweatshirt, and Paw Shoulder Bag. Plush mascots are priced at 3,200 yen each and both variants sold out at launch, with shipping estimated for late November. WANNYANZ is the established fan name for the Alban Knox and Sonny Brisko pairing; both are members of NIJISANJI EN's Noctyx wave, and they previously appeared together in a voice pack release. This is their first dedicated physical merchandise line.

stories.title: Jacksepticeye debuts as a VTuber November 19 — medieval knight model designed by Kavalliere; debut tied to Ironmouse's Wishmas charity drive for Make-A-Wish; $1 donations revealed avatar incrementally
stories.blurb: Irish creator Sean McLoughlin (Jacksepticeye) launched his VTuber avatar on November 19 at 8:30 AM ET as part of his annual Wishmas campaign for Make-A-Wish. Ironmouse organized the reveal format: viewer donations incrementally unveiled the avatar ahead of the stream, with each dollar bringing more of the model into view. The avatar is a full-armor medieval knight with cloak, sword, and lantern, designed by Kavalliere with concept art by epebe and rigging by Remmiise. Reception split across non-anime design enthusiasm, physics complaints, and McLaughlin's past controversy history. No agency affiliation was announced; the project was described as Wishmas-specific. It is the highest-profile VTuber avatar debut from an established YouTube creator this calendar year.

stories.title: Streamer Awards 2026 rigging claims expand through the week — QTCinderella briefly posts vote margins then deletes them citing community toxicity; scrutiny covers both Best Stream Duo and Best VTuber
stories.blurb: In the week following the November 12 ceremony, rigging allegations extended from Best Stream Duo — where B Lou, whose team lost to Katie B and Vanillamace, raised the allegation directly — to Best VTuber as well. QTCinderella posted the full vote margins for contested categories and then deleted them, citing the community using the data to attack creators rather than resolve disputes. The brief margins window showed the VTuber category was not close; the duo result was tighter but within what the stated voting system predicts. The nomination process — which includes one panel-selected nominee per category — remains the structural objection. No category result was changed. The controversy follows the same structural debate that has run in some form since the 2022 Streamer Awards.

stories.title: Kemono Friends V Project announces four new Friends for November 28-29 debut — Chipmunk EX, Jungle Cat EX, Tsuchinoko, and Jinmengyo join the official IP VTuber unit
stories.blurb: The official Kemono Friends VTuber project announced four new members on November 20, with first streams scheduled for November 28-29. The wave includes two EX-category Friends — Chipmunk EX and Jungle Cat EX — alongside cryptid-category additions Tsuchinoko and Jinmengyo. The Kemono Friends V Project is run under Age Global Networks' Kemono Friends IP and extends the franchise's VTuber presence; exact debut stream times are on individual channels. The EX designation marks characters adapted from expanded materials outside the original anime; Tsuchinoko and Jinmengyo both draw from Japanese folklore, following the franchise's pattern of pulling from real animal and creature categories. Stream archives will be available on the Kemono Friends V Project YouTube channel.

indies.title: Leannleo debuts November 21 — closes the November indie cohort that opened with Lumafly VT on November 2; five independent debuts across four weeks; next debuts move to December
indies.blurb: Independent VTuber Leannleo held their debut stream on November 21, closing a November indie calendar that ran five entries across the month: Lumafly VT (Nov 2), SpacePrinceEdenVT (Nov 3), CrazyTama and Lucieliya (Nov 11), Cassian Aetheria (Nov 16), and Leannleo (Nov 21). The November cohort launched against an unusually active ambient viewership window — the Streamer Awards ceremony, Suisei's Fukuoka tour finale, Shattered Legends, and the Ironmouse win all drew elevated cross-community traffic through the first three weeks of the month, widening the organic discovery window for debuts landing in this stretch. Per hololist.net, the indie debut calendar shifts to December.

tea.text: The /vt/ Jacksepticeye VTuber thread opened at 8:29 AM ET on November 19, one minute before the Wishmas reveal. The first post observed that this was happening. The second post asked whether Ironmouse had recruited him. Posts three through forty worked through the knight model's design from first principles, reaching a consensus that the armor is well-constructed, the physics are controversial, and the sword is too small relative to the gauntlets. The thread's charity section noted that Make-A-Wish is a legitimate organization, then continued arguing about the physics. The thread's classification section — is he a VTuber, an avatar user, a charitable asset, or something the existing taxonomy does not cover — arrived at hour two and has not resolved. Word on /vt/ is that the question is not whether he streamed. The question is what category the stream falls into. The thread is building a glossary. The glossary currently has four entries. All four entries are contested.

The /vt/ post-Streamer Awards margin thread started as a Best Stream Duo grievance, which is not traditionally a /vt/ concern, and by day four had reorganized into a broader structural question about whether posting and then deleting vote margins is worse than not posting them at all. The thread concluded it probably is. The secondary question was whether the margins, while they were briefly visible, resolved anything. The thread concluded the Best VTuber section of the debate was resolved. The tertiary question was whether resolving the VTuber section of a broader rigging argument while leaving the duo section open creates a net information gain or a net symmetry problem. The thread has been on that question for three days. QTCinderella has not re-posted the margins. The thread is not expecting her to. The thread is monitoring for the possibility anyway.

The /vt/ hololive 8th fes. lineup speculation thread opened approximately twenty minutes after the official ticket announcement on Thursday. The first structural observation was that Tokoyami Towa will not appear, which the thread noted is confirmed in the official materials. The thread immediately treated this as the most interesting data point in the announcement. It produced four categories of explanation, assigned rough probability estimates to each, and noted that the categories are not mutually exclusive. The lineup for the 8th fes. has not otherwise been announced; the thread is running predictions based on cross-referencing the 7th fes. lineup, upcoming tour and concert schedules running into March 2027, and a hand-maintained spreadsheet that someone in the thread is updating after each piece of new information. The spreadsheet is linked in the OP. The thread recommends not reading too much into it. The thread continues to update it. The spreadsheet now has thirty-seven rows.

The Phase Connect Filian thread has entered what the board is calling the Documentation Phase. The original question — whether and when the debut happens — is now a secondary question. The primary question is which of last month's predicted scenarios has arrived, changed, or been superseded. The thread is cross-referencing posts from October and November and assessing which predictions remain live. The assessment is complicated by the fact that none of the predictions named a specific date, so none can be fully ruled out. The thread has started a glossary. The glossary defines the door just opens one day as the scenario where there is no advance announcement and the stream simply appears on the schedule with no lead time. Word on /vt/ is that something is in motion but the thread's operational definition of motion means only that people are still posting. The Documentation Phase is ongoing. The glossary has six entries. All six entries are contested. This is noted in the glossary.

footerNote: Next signal drops Monday, 30 November — the debrief week for AFA Singapore and DreamHack Stockholm, the final Monday before Hakos Baelz takes the Kanadevia Hall stage December 1, and three weeks from Suisei's Datte Boku wa. The year is almost over. See you in seven.
